purpose: Controlled sample testing whether support change correlates with translation/copy-state change. The sample is deliberately designed to include both positive and negative cases.
core_result: Support change can coincide with documentary conversion, but there is no invariant mapping such as translation = machine-made paper. Paper support is one state variable among language, hand, format, copy relation and intended use.

supported: Some documentary conversions coincide with support conversion, especially palm-leaf/local documentary witnesses translated onto machine-made paper.
Format may change even where support type is not known or remains local, as in pre-bound notebook translations.
Translation can remain on Nepali hand-made paper, so support origin is not a simple marker of linguistic or epistemic stage.
rejected_or_not_supported: support type alone identifies epistemic authority
provisional_pattern.next_test: Expand pair sample and model support, language, hand, format, date, destination and copy relation as independent variables; then test recurring combinations rather than binary correlations.
